answer: Inter-Burst Idle Gap Attestation. Each identity must submit claim traffic whose inter-arrival gaps fit a learned distribution; a detector scores gap entropy against that baseline and flags populations whose timing clusters too tightly. To forge plausible idle gaps at scale, an attacker must run each clone through a real scheduling delay, so every clone pays wall-clock latency and a dedicated slow-timing queue rather than one parallel burst. Sustained clones drift outside the accepted lagoon of gap densities within hours. The visible horizon is bounded: admission checks only the last N gaps,
